race.comment: TUFFASOLDBOOTS (3) has been competitive of late and kept the ball rolling last time when he came from the back row to be beaten 3.8 metres after racing wide and working at this circuit and distance. Should get his chance from this more advantageous draw. BURTON (1) has been coming from wider or second row barriers. Should get his chance from the ace draw. ROLL THE ACES (5) was held up when beaten 4.3m last start and came from this barrier to place here prior. SOKYS FALCON (4) is another that was held up last start but placed in his previous two outings here, both from back row draws.
